entities.name: José Goncalves Heleno
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jose Gonçalves Heleno was a Brazilian Roman Catholic prelate. He was first appointed a coadjutor bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Governador Valadares from 1976 to 1977. He then served as the Bishop of Governador Valadares from 7 December 1977 until his retirement on 25 April 2001.
